The owner reports step C5 passed with normal camera behaviour afterwards.

## Procedure and coverage

Package that reads a 32-byte header from OM5MOD/BUNDLES.BIN at the first gated half-press; tried with and without the file on the card.

- Caduceus 0.3; half-press, photos, playback, menu and video normal with and without the card file.

## Limits and assumptions

- The owner names packages by short hash; no installed-file readout was reported.
- Whether the read succeeded is not visible on the camera; the status word is in RAM only.
- Results are dated 2026-11-08 in the work log; the test date is not stated separately.
- One owner on one camera; not independently reproduced.
